faqs.q: Sec. 18-474. - I.P.M.C. Section 107.3, Method of service.
faqs.a:
Section 107.3. Method of service,
is hereby amended to read as follows:
"
107.3. Method of service.
Such notice shall be deemed to be properly served if a copy thereof is:
1.
Delivered personally; or
2.
Sent by certified or first-class mail addressed to the last known address of the owner;
                  or
3.
If the notice is returned showing that the letter was not delivered, a copy thereof
                  shall be posted in a conspicuous place in or about the structure affected by such
                  notice."
(Ord. No.
4738
, § 12, 9-14-2020)
